Soil No. ① is labeled with water as 26% and air as 14%; soil No. ② is labeled with water as 45% and air as 5%; soil No. ③ is labeled with water as 5% and air as 35%; soil No. ④ is labeled with water as 4% and air as 50%. Among them, the water proportion of soil No. ② is the highest, obviously higher than the other three. In the diagram, soil No. ② has water accounting for 45%, making it the most suitable for rice planting, so the answer is the 2nd type.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中四个编号土壤结构饼图分别给出矿物质、有机质、水、空气的比例，其中②号土壤水分标注为45%，明显高于①的26%、③的5%和④的4%，且②空气仅5%。再结合题目问“适合水稻种植的土壤”，利用水稻需水量大、适宜湿润水田土壤的知识，选择水分比例最高、最能满足水稻生长的②号土壤。
